PROPOSED AI / SEO WORK / AGREED SCOPE

Turn a search observation into useful work.

Help the right buyer discover PAC, understand the application fit and start a useful sales conversation.

01 / DIAGNOSE

Map buyer questions.

Agree target applications and questions. Record observed supplier mentions, cited sources and the PAC pages that answer each need.

02 / BUILD

Make PAC’s answers useful.

Prepare one priority application-page draft with PAC-approved facts, matching product media and an inquiry path. Identify content and technical fixes.

03 / REVIEW

Measure the response.

Repeat the agreed questions and review available search and referral signals alongside inquiry quality. Keep the observations and limitations visible.

Two-week evaluation output

An agreed question baseline, source-linked observations, a prioritized backlog, one application-page draft and a measurement plan. PAC checks relevance, factual accuracy and traceability. Publishing is included only if agreed before the start.

Why continue after the trial?

The separately scoped paid service implements approved improvements, maintains changing product information and reviews visibility and inquiry quality on an agreed schedule. Scope, fees and support are confirmed together. A particular answer, ranking or lead increase is not guaranteed.

Practical SEO foundations

Check crawl access and indexing eligibility, internal links, readable page content, relevant images and video, and consistency between visible content and structured data. Google says its AI search features need no special AI schema and inclusion is not guaranteed. This guidance supports the proposed Google SEO work; it does not explain how ChatGPT produced Patrick’s answer. Google Search Central ↗
